title: Smiling Couple, Wooden Clapboard Siding - Vintage 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful full-length snapshot of a smiling couple standing side-by-side against a wooden lap-siding exterior wall. The man sports slicked-back hair with a middle part, a crisp white button-down shirt, necktie, wide-buckled textured light belt, pocket watch chain, and dark trousers. The woman stands warmly beside him, resting her hand behind his waist, wearing a drop-waist light-colored summer dress with a Peter Pan collar and matching white shoes. Both exhibit radiant, happy expressions reflecting typical everyday domestic life in late 1920s America.
